name: clmm_tick_crossing
why: a concentrated-liquidity swap that moves the pool price across at least one tick boundary, i.e. pre_sqrt_price != post_sqrt_price by more than one tick's worth

name: liquidity_no_swap
why: an add or remove of liquidity on a phase 2 venue. Both mints move the SAME way across the pool, so it must decode to NO swap at all

name: multi_hop_route
why: an aggregator route whose hops land on DIFFERENT phase 2 venues: it must become one swap per venue, each credited to the venue and not to the router

name: token_2022_fee
why: a swap on a mint with a Token-2022 transfer fee, where what the pool SENT and what the taker RECEIVED differ - and where the venue event's idea of the input leg differs from the movement layer's by exactly that fee
